text: In the NARMA-10 lab, increasing the reservoir size N drives the test NMSE up (worse) because larger reservoirs overfit the task.
explanation: False: the lab observes NMSE decreases roughly as 1/N because more neurons add nonlinear approximation capacity. There are diminishing returns, but larger N does not make NARMA-10 worse — ridge regularization (λ=1e-6) controls overfitting.
